answer: To resist Sybil attacks, give every new agent an island probation: it starts isolated, trading only inside its own island, and must finish publicly checkable tasks recorded in a crystal ledger all can inspect. Leaving the island needs an ivory audit: three established agents from unrelated islands independently re-run the work and sign off only if it matches. A forged record, a duplicated task, or one sponsor vouching for many newcomers at once freezes the lineage and burns the sponsor's standing, so fake identities cost more than they earn. Wider trading waits for that audit.
